items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: when John and Paul threw back the Arab squad

ctx.x: And then after that, we went to the Triechter in Hamburg, and we stayed there another four weeks. Then we made a tour all the way out to Turkey. And we played all the way along. We were seeing nothing but the casinos. Like the San Sebastien Casino in San Sebastien. Well, it was one of the places where the Spanish king stayed in the summertime. And then we played in Italy, in Milano and Florence and -- we didn't play Rome for some reason, we had to leave. I don't know what happened. And then we went back to Vienna…
And we was well thought of in Vienna. In fact, we really loved Vienna.
